{
  "artifact_path": ".sdlc/runs/20260826-103235-feature-extend-board-filter-chips/change_plan.md",
  "d1_state_ownership": "URL search parameters are the sole source of truth; filters state is derived synchronously on every render from search params via pure memoization with no useState owning filter state and no isInitializedRef.",
  "seed_oneshot_mechanism": "seededStorageKeyRef stores the active storageKey string and executes seed navigation only once per storageKey when search params have no active filters, preventing re-fires when the navigation updates URL params.",
  "hook_signature": "export function useTaskFiltersWithLabelsSupport(project: Project | undefined, searchFilters?: BoardSearchParams, onFiltersChange?: (filters: BoardFilters) => void): { filters: BoardFilters; setFilters: (filters: BoardFilters | ((prev: BoardFilters) => BoardFilters)) => void; updateFilter: <K extends keyof BoardFilters>(key: K, value: BoardFilters[K]) => void; updateLabelFilter: (labelId: string) => void; filteredProject: Project | undefined; hasActiveFilters: boolean; clearFilters: () => void; }",
  "d2_accepted_shapes": [
    "JSON-encoded array (?status=[\"todo\",\"review\"])",
    "Repeated query keys (?status=todo&status=review)",
    "Bare single string (?status=todo)"
  ],
  "acs_changed": [
    "AC-2: Changes from mount-time React state hydration effect with precedence guards to direct search param derivation on Render 1 and asynchronous mirror write to localStorage",
    "AC-3: Changes from restoring internal React state from localStorage to issuing a one-shot seed replace navigation to the URL when search params are empty"
  ],
  "risks_dropped": [
    "Unconditional initial localStorage clobber (v1 Risk 1) dropped because URL is sole truth and no un-hydrated React filter state exists to overwrite storage",
    "Two-way binding render loops and race conditions dropped due to unidirectional data flow from URL"
  ],
  "risks_added": [
    "Storage key seed re-trigger failure across workspace/project switching (mitigated by keying ref with storageKey string)",
    "Functional search updater shallow merge dropping custom query parameters (mitigated by spreading ...prev in all updaters)"
  ],
  "uncertainties": [],
  "files_written": [
    ".sdlc/runs/20260826-103235-feature-extend-board-filter-chips/change_plan.md"
  ]
}
